verdict.rationale: Flagright publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages, request and response fields, and sandbox server URLs (including a default server and regional servers). It also offers downloadable OpenAPI specs and says you can interact with the API directly via Postman, which supports exploring and running requests. However, nothing documents an in-page interactive "try it" console or runnable code examples within the reference itself. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable code samples on reference pages, and hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
